title: report-specification-storage
responsibility: Measures the unit-manifest JSON store and append-only budget ledger, reporting byte/line counts and conservative operator heads-up thresholds without proposing retention or deletion policy.

inputs.name: specificationStorageReport.root
inputs.description: Repository root containing specification/units and specification/budgets/ledger.ndjson.

outputs.name: specificationStorageReport
outputs.type: Promise<{ units: { files: number; bytes: number }; budgetLedger: { bytes: number; lines: number }; operatorHeadsUpBytes: { units: number; budgetLedger: number }; warnings: string[] }>
outputs.description: Report of unit JSON file count and bytes, ledger bytes and line count, configured heads-up byte levels, and any threshold warnings.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An unreadable budget-ledger stream rejects the report; missing files/directories are treated as zero or empty by the stat/list helpers.
